# observe Provider

Manage [Observe](https://observe.live) monitors, alerting and status pages as code, through the v1 API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    observe = {
      source = "observe-live/observe"
    }
  }
}

# The token comes from OBSERVE_TOKEN and the organization from OBSERVE_ORGANIZATION_ID when not set here.
provider "observe" {
  organization_id = "01JCX4ZK7N2Q8V3W5Y6A9B0C1D"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) API base URL. Defaults to `OBSERVE_ENDPOINT`, else `https://observe.live/api/v1`.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization that resources go in unless they set their own. Defaults to `OBSERVE_ORGANIZATION_ID`.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) API token with read and write access (Profile → API & data). Defaults to `OBSERVE_TOKEN`.
